meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Expert data processing with a hybrid engine strategy: resident-kernel DuckDB first (persistent js/py eval kernels where the harness has them, bun/uv one-shots elsewhere), Python Polars/numpy/matplotlib through uv where they win, and per-action placement judgment (in-memory vs streaming vs remote-in-place). Triggers: 'analyze the data', 'what is in this CSV/parquet/json', 'summarize this', 'group by', 'filter rows', 'sort by', 'join these files', 'merge datasets', 'time series trend', 'compare yesterday and today', 'distribution/histogram', 'correlation', 'clean duplicates', 'handle missing values', 'dataset larger than RAM', 'SQL query on files', 'DataFrame operations', 'chart/plot this data', DuckDB vs Polars selection, quick data exploration CLI. NOT for plain text/code inspection, configs, or tiny inline math.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析各种数据文件,快速完成统计汇总与图表绘制
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常与CSV、表格数据打交道,想快速完成清洗、统计和可视化。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze data files and produce summaries and charts in minutes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with CSV and tabular data and need quick summaries and visuals.

howto.what: Claude 会选引擎并决定计算方式(内存/流式/远程),直接查 CSV/Parquet/JSON 等文件,做分组、聚合、排序等处理;需要时画图并报告行数和耗时;不用 pandas,Excel 需先转 CSV/Parquet。
howto.when: 当你说“分析这些数据”等探索指令,或要求分组、过滤等数据处理时触发;不用于纯文本、配置检查或简单数学。

say.text: 分析这个 CSV,按类别分组并统计销售额。
say.note: 会用 DuckDB 直接查文件并返回分组汇总。

say.text: 这个 CSV 和那个 JSON 能按 id 合并吗?
say.note: 会尝试连接两个文件并输出匹配结果。

say.text: 内存不够,这个 Parquet 文件有几十 GB,怎么算每月的趋势?
say.note: 会改用流式处理,避免占满内存。

howto.what_en: Claude picks an engine and placement (memory/streaming/remote), queries CSV/Parquet/JSON directly for grouping, aggregation, sorting, etc.; charts on request, reports counts and timing; never pandas; Excel must be exported.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to analyze data, or request grouping, filtering, etc.; not for plain text, config checks, or simple math.

say_en.text: Analyze this CSV, group by category and sum sales.
say_en.note: Uses DuckDB to query the file and return grouped totals.

say_en.text: Can you join this CSV with that JSON on id?
say_en.note: Attempts to join the files and output matches.

say_en.text: This Parquet is tens of GB, not enough RAM; how to compute monthly trend?
say_en.note: Switches to streaming to avoid running out of memory.
